natural_body: 40% SMB discount: +31% signups, +18% rev, -12% ret; judge at renewal

first.rationale: I intend to test simplified onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding to faster time-to-value and stronger early adoption. I will verify the onboarding result and the pricing result before committing: aggressive discounting may recover price-sensitive SMB signups and revenue, but the observed retention decline creates a material long-term qualified-revenue risk. Use a standard experiment with guardrails on activation, qualified revenue, and retention.
